questions.question: Who is Tiger?
questions.explanation: Tiger introduces himself as a snail and an inventor.

questions.question: Why does Tiger dig holes at the edge of the field?
answers: To plant trees that hold water
questions.explanation: He explains that tree roots help hold water in the soil.

questions.question: What are Tera's friends called?
questions.explanation: Tola (the kitten) and Urwis (the dog) help Tera.

questions.question: What happens after the first storm?
answers: The soil becomes moist and the corn revives
The field gets flooded and destroyed
questions.explanation: Thanks to the trees the rain stays in the soil and the corn looks better.
